patent.ref: Gabriel Kazanjian receives US 994,259 for a hand-manipulated hair drier, filed in 1908; its fan is manually driven
patent.ref_zh: 加布里埃尔·卡赞坚的手持式干发装置获 US 994,259 专利；1908 年申请，风扇由手动机构驱动

locations.place_label_zh: 美国芝加哥（专利所列卡赞坚居住地）
locations.place_label_en: Chicago, USA (Kazanjian residence named in patent)

sources.title: Halliwell hair dryer, electric, c.1920 — Science Museum Group

notes: 1911 年指一项具体改良专利的授权，不是所有干发装置或现代电动吹风机的首次发明。该专利的风扇由手动机构驱动；约 1920 年馆藏电吹风的制造地点未据此推定。
notes_en: 1911 marks a specific improvement patent, not the first drying apparatus or modern motor-driven dryer. Its fan was manually driven; no manufacture location is inferred for the circa-1920 museum object.
summary_zh: 1911 年卡赞坚获手持式干发装置专利，将加热器与手动风扇结合。科学博物馆另藏约 1920 年的电吹风，呈现干发器具走向电气化的过程。
summary_en: Kazanjian patented a hand-manipulated hair drier in 1911, pairing a heater with a manual fan. A circa-1920 electric Halliwell dryer in the Science Museum documents later electrification.
